units.source_text: 再说那个柏木卫门督，一向常在朱雀院邸内出入，与朱雀院十分亲昵，因此详细了解他疼爱三公主的心情。

en.t: Now Kashiwagi, the Captain of the Right Gate Guard, had long been a frequent visitor at the Suzaku院 residence and was very intimate with him, so he knew in detail how deeply Suzaku院 loved the Third Princess.

units.source_text: 朱雀院替三公主择婿时，柏木闻知种种消息，自己也曾提出求婚，朱雀院并不认为不当。

en.t: When Suzaku院 was choosing a husband for the Third Princess, Kashiwagi heard various reports and himself proposed marriage, and Suzaku院 did not think the match improper.

units.source_text: 后来三公主终于嫁给了源氏，柏木大为失望，心中十分悲伤，直到如今不能忘怀。

en.t: Later, when the Third Princess finally married Genji, Kashiwagi was bitterly disappointed and deeply saddened, and even now he could not forget her.

units.source_text: 他那时曾央三公主的侍女小侍从替他撮合，现在就从这侍女那里探询三公主的情况，聊以自慰，真乃画饼点饥。

en.t: At that time he had asked the Third Princess's attendant, Kojuiju, to act as go-between for him; now he questioned that same attendant about the princess and consoled himself with such news, like trying to satisfy hunger with a painted cake.

units.source_text: 他听见世人传说：三公主也被紫夫人的威势所压倒，便对三公主的乳母的女儿——亦即他自己的乳母的甥女——小侍从发牢骚，说道：

en.t: When he heard people say that even the Third Princess was overawed by Lady Murasaki's influence, he complained to Kojuiju, the daughter of the princess's nurse and also the niece of his own nurse, saying:
"The princess is being treated far too unfairly!

units.source_text: 要是嫁给了我，决不致受这种闲气。

en.t: If she had married me, she would never have had to endure such humiliation.

units.source_text: 虽然她是金枝玉叶，我高攀不上……”

en.t: Though she is of such exalted birth that I could never truly aspire to her..."

units.source_text: 他时时刻刻在想：“世事变化无定。

en.t: He was constantly thinking, "The affairs of the world are changeable and uncertain.

units.source_text: 六条院主人早有出家修行之意，如果一旦毅然实行，这三公主终归我有。”

en.t: The master of Rokujo院 has long intended to leave the world and take up religious practice; if he should one day carry that out decisively, this Third Princess will at last be mine."
